How it works

One tag in every apartment

  1. The guest taps the tag

    The apartment's page opens on their phone: guide, Wi-Fi, check-out and local tips.

  2. The AI host answers or acts

    Questions are answered straight away. Problems become jobs for your cleaner or maintenance.

  3. You see everything in one place

    Open jobs, response times, cleaning status and which apartments need attention.

  4. Happy guests come back direct

    Guests join your list for a discount on their next stay, booked on your own site.

Why GEO matters

Your next guest will ask AI, not a booking platform.

People already ask AI assistants about everything: where to eat, what to see, and more and more often where to stay, in an apartment or a hotel. AI doesn't answer with a list of a hundred listings. It recommends a few places by name. If yours is one of them, with a link to your own site, the guest books directly with you, and you pay no platform commission.

  1. 1

    The guest asks AI

    "A quiet apartment in Ljubljana with parking?" in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Google's AI answers.

  2. 2

    AI recommends you by name

    With a short description and a link to your own booking site, not to a platform listing.

  3. 3

    The guest books directly

    0% platform commission. Only about 3% in card payment fees, instead of up to 15.5%.

GEO (generative engine optimisation) makes sure AI assistants know your property, understand what it offers and can recommend it. AI learns from what is written about you on the web today, so the hosts and hotels that are visible first will get these bookings. That's why we start GEO in the pilot.

Questions

What hosts ask us first

Does it replace Airbnb or Booking.com?

No. Unbusyness works alongside them. The AI host and the tags work for every guest, and your own booking site gradually brings returning guests to book with you directly.

What happens when something breaks at night?

The AI host helps the guest first. If it can't be solved, it creates a job for your cleaner or maintenance with the apartment, the problem and how urgent it is, and lets you know only when you're needed.

Do guests need an app?

No. They tap the NFC tag with their phone or scan the QR code, and the apartment's page opens in the browser.

Which languages does the AI host speak?

It answers in the guest's language. Anything it can't answer is passed to you.

What is GEO and why does it matter?

GEO (generative engine optimisation) is like SEO for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. More and more travellers ask them where to stay. When the AI recommends your apartment by name and links to your own site, the guest books directly and you pay no platform commission.

What will it cost?

During the pilot: €12 per apartment per month, at least €49 a month. Your own booking site with SEO and GEO is €99 a month on top.

I have one apartment. Is it worth it?

Yes, if guest messages take your evenings or you want more direct bookings. The minimum is €49 a month.
